name: Last Door
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 12
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Uncanny Sense
Traits.text: The last door can pinpoint the location of living creatures that have made a sound within 60 feet of itself.
Traits.gmQuote: the sound of a door closing in an empty house

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The last door can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the last door has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The last door makes two Slam Echo Strike attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Hollowing Gaze.

Actions.name: Slam Echo Strike
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Hollowing Gaze
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: It is what remains of a house's last moment of abandonment, a wandering spirit that drifts through walls to drain the warmth from the living until it hears a final click over living ears.
